result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main visible defect is the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' list being clipped mid-word ('Tokumaru Rameı') even though there is ample horizontal space before the rating badge, indicating a text container width or overflow bug rather than intentional truncation.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' section is hard-clipped to 'Tokumaru Rameı' with no ellipsis, despite plenty of free space between the title and the 4.8 rating on the right. The last letter is partially cut, so the title container appears to have an incorrect fixed width or overflow clipping.
issues.suggestion: Let the title flex to fill available width up to the rating element, and use proper text truncation with an ellipsis (text-overflow: ellipsis / maxLines with TextOverflow.ellipsis) instead of hard clipping so names are never cut mid-glyph.
